# Travel per diem (2026)

| Country | Meals per day | Incidentals per day |
|---|---|---|
| Germany | 48 | 12 |
| France | 44 | 10 |
| Japan | 52 | 14 |
| Singapore | 46 | 11 |

Notes:
- Rates are in USD and apply from the second day of a trip.
- On the first and last day only 75% of the meal rate is paid.
- Meals provided by the host are deducted: breakfast 20%, lunch 30%, dinner 50% of the meal rate.

turns.prompt: What is the daily meal allowance in Japan, and what percentage of it do I get on the first day of the trip?
